versions.content: Pre-configuraton of ROE events If DcmDspRoeIni- tialEventStatus is set to DCM_ROE_STOPPED , the Dcm shall behave according RoeEvent set-up: • StorageState set to "StoreEvent" • EventWindowTime set to "infinity" • DTCStatusMask set to value configured in DcmDspRoeDTCStatusMask in case of onDTCStatusChange and • DID set to the value given with DcmDspRoeDidRef in case of onChangeOf- DataIdentifier
